facts.text: GymHabitatEnv is a gym.Wrapper that builds an RLTaskEnv and wraps it in HabGymWrapper to expose the standard Gym API
make_gym_from_config returns the gym.Env for the environment class named by habitat.env_task
Habitat-v0 is registered with entry point _make_habitat_gym_env, which takes cfg_file_path and override_options
HabGymWrapper.step returns the legacy four-value tuple (observation, reward, done, info)
HabGymWrapper.reset resets the wrapped environment and returns its initial observation
The wrapper flattens a continuous action space into one Box, uses Discrete(n) for a single discrete action, and Discrete(len(actions)) otherwise
For the point-navigation test configuration the gym action space is Discrete(4)
The point-navigation task defines the four actions stop, move_forward, turn_left and turn_right
move_forward advances the agent by forward_step_size 0.25 m and the turn actions rotate it by turn_angle 10 degrees
The point-navigation test environment allows 500 steps per episode
The point-navigation test environment's rgb and depth sensors are 256 by 256 pixels
The point-goal observation is polar with dimensionality 2
The distance_to_goal_reward measure is -(new_distance - previous_distance), the decrease of the distance to the goal

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its goal placement with reset(seed=...) and its motion is deterministic, so one seed repeats an episode; the upstream legacy gym wrapper seeds through env.seed(), which the bridge falls back to, and habitat-sim's own randomisation was not exercised

gaps: kinematic point-navigation stand-in: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, articulated arm, grasping or physics; the agent moves by forward_step_size and rotates by turn_angle directly
timestep_ms is 0 because this model is event-driven analytic; habitat-sim's physics timestep lives in the separate habitat-sim repository and was not run
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and no control-loop timing is modelled
the rgb and depth observations are 12- and 4-number flat stand-ins; the point-nav test config declares 256 x 256 x 3 rgb and 256 x 256 x 1 depth sensors, and the fake does not render
the reward models only the distance-to-goal decrease; the slack reward, success reward and termination by success are not modelled
the fake was never compared with habitat-sim or a real run; snapshot and restore are not offered

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: the runtime latches the e-stop and refuses further step, reset and seed calls until mhs.safety.reset clears it; the environment state is kept and stays readable
